method: Identical GHJU factory with real Shadow armour, original 34-bone RLH rig in its unscaled local authoring frame. Standing and running at 7 units/s; 60 warm-up frames, jump impulse 7.25, gravity 18, 100 measured frames at 60 Hz including landing and return to locomotion. Kinematic position/angular measurements; not hardware FPS.

units.landingHipDrop: local metres from warm-up pelvis to lowest post-contact pelvis
